annotations.title: Move a recording to its session

description: Put a recording on the session it really was, as the session view's "Wrong session?" picker does — for when the sync matched it wrong: the watch profile was not the planned sport (roller skiing recorded as inline skating, filed as an extra), or two sessions of a sport share a day (a commute took the planned trainer ride). workout_id is the session holding the recording now; to_workout_id the session it belongs on (ids from get_training_plan). The rules, as the app's "Wrong session?" picker has them: onto a session of the same day (one that already holds a recording swaps with it), or onto a planned session of the day before or after that has no recording — that session moves to the day the recording was made. Leave to_workout_id out to keep the recording as an extra session; the session it leaves is planned again. An extra that gives its recording up is deleted (its RPE and notes go along when the target has none). Bricks are not moved by hand. A recording placed by hand stays put: later syncs do not re-seat it. A recording of one sport put on a planned session of another teaches the sync a stand-in for this athlete (inline skate can fill roller ski), used only when no session of the recording's own sport is planned that day. The athlete is told in their bell. The reply has an undo: the same call with the ids it gives.

to_workout_id.description: The session it belongs on. Leave out to keep it as an extra session.

workout_id.description: The session the recording is on now
